properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jsonwebtoken 11.1.0 is the JWT library for the whole auth surface: first-party signing happens with RS256 (RSA-2048, Shor-vulnerable — src/auth.rs:44,124,138 signs every login/invite/admin/send/API-key/file-download token) and HS512 (Duo OIDC client assertions, src/api/core/two_factor/duo_oidc.rs:38,137). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLS 1.3 is negotiated by rustls 0.23.45 for the server's HTTPS listener (rocket "tls" feature, ROCKET_TLS env), outbound HTTPS (reqwest) and SMTP TLS (lettre). The protocol version is PQ-fine; the negotiated key exchange is not: with the ring provider (Cargo.toml:128) the TLS 1.3 groups are classical-only (X25519/secp256r1/secp384r1) — rustls's X25519MLKEM768 hybrid is unavailable in this build, so all three surfaces are harvest-now-decrypt-later.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: argon2 0.6.0 (Cargo.toml:251, "Argon2 library with support for the PHC format") is the password-hashing library for the admin panel token and user master-password KDF when Argon2id is configured; the call sites are inventoried under the Argon2id algorithm object (ALG-d75ee937, other shard). Not Shor-relevant — Grover halves a memory-hard KDF's strength at most. This entry is the crate pin that ships it.

properties.name: pqs:context

Confirm-and-leave; not Shor-relevant, flagged weak-hash class only if used for security.
